'''Lewis Blake Celebrate Pucumir and Force Drains''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Lewis Blake]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-2754">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/2754 Celebrate Pucumir and Force Drains], DeckTech (Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake, 30 January 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/2754/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/2754/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018210613/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/2754/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lewis Blake]]
* '''Published:''' 30 January 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Celebrate Pucumir and Force Drains''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bespin|CC-L-bespin.gif}}

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Bespin Blake LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Use Mr. Thryss, the mains, and force drain the heck out of your opponent.

== Original post ==

'''Celebrate Pucumir and Force Drains'''
* '''Author:''' Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake
* '''Published:''' January 30, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Use Mr. Thryss, the mains, and force drain the heck out of your opponent.

=== Strategy ===

Use Pucumir, Harc Seff, and Kebyc to help raise your and reduce their force draining Lightsabers on mains to enhace force drains Insurrection + ability 2 rebels to have high forfeits Cloud City Clebration to retrieve force Fleet + Incom Engineer to ensure control of Bespin and B Cloud City Path of Least Resistance and Revolution are just annoying cards to use It's Not My Fault is a card I don't see much, but has a 5 destiny, helps with protecting EPPs, and is a used interrupt instead of lost Obi-Wan's Cape is to protect EPPs Fire Quad Laser, then, if you miss, fire Intruder Missle for a +3 destiny.  The 7s and 4 on the starship weapons are also nice
